column1: # rt_entries.tsv -- THE RUNTIME ENTRY TABLE (DESIGN-PLAN zeta-layout step 5, stage 5a; ARCH-ZETA-LAYOUT-ONE-SOURCE-OF-TRUTH.md section 3 R4; CEO-2019): one row per runtime symbol emitted code calls.

# sym        the symbol a template names in x86("call"), x86("call_bare") or x86_rtcc_call, or that src/runtime/rtx registers as an asm-runtime entry (RTX_FUNC, RTX_ENTRY): the emitter asks the table about both.
# conv       leaf | gen | open | asm: "asm" where src/runtime/rtx declares it with RTX_FUNC or RTX_ENTRY; "-" where no source states it (stage 5b declares it at the definition).
# rc         what rides rax:rdx at return: DESCR | OTHER | VOID | UNKNOWN, as src/templates/x86/gc_allocating_table.inc states it; "-" where that table has no row.

# allocates  1 when the symbol is a row of gc_allocating_table.inc, 0 when it is not (a symbol defined in libscrip_rt.so, an asm entry, or a libc import: libc allocates nothing on the collected heap).

# clobbers   which of the four RTCC registers (r8 r9 r10 r11) the entry hands back changed; "none" is an explicit empty mask; "-" where no source states it. The asm rows are DERIVED from the assembled objects (util_gen_rt_entry_table.py --sync-asm; --check-asm refuses a stale one) and the emitter reads them (stage 5c).
# transfers  may return an address the box jumps to (the rt_call_next_t shape): "-" until stage 5b declares it.
# src        which sources state the row: call (a template names it), alloc (gc_allocating_table.inc has it), clob (the objects derive its clobbers), asm (src/runtime/rtx registers it), import.
